scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w mcp
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
